purpose: Slice 135 bounded first inspectable Phase 1 results; not the full checkpoint
model: none; CPU real-engine text and lifecycle subset

conditions.resource_scope: GNU Time child process plus host boundary snapshots

statistics.point_estimate: median of five pair deltas for each cell and percentile
statistics.uncertainty: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10000 paired-block bootstrap medians, resampling five pairs with replacement using Python Random(135); diagnostic interval, not a release acceptance threshold
statistics.report: all five pair deltas, median, bootstrap interval, maximum, valid fractions, child CPU/RSS/IO, warnings and invalid attempts

validity.source_and_artifact_hashes: exact match required; source tree and resolved Cargo lock checked
validity.semantic_checks: all declared output and state checks true per attempt
validity.host_swap_drift: retain exact count as warning if child swap events are zero
validity.other_environment_invalidators: governor, source, settings, storage or toolchain drift; swap in child; named competing job at block boundary; disk pressure; malformed or missing resource report
validity.invalid_block: retain raw attempt and reason; repeat its assigned pair slot only after cause is addressed; never replace a valid slow sample

attribution: run stage timers, sampled stacks and compiler coverage separately from primary timing; rank fixed-operation aggregate cost only on candidate
limits: engine-only first-results subset; no installed SDK, vector, hybrid, graph, cross-host, p99 or full Phase 1 release verdict
